fields.summary: Stock not syncing from warehouse after bulk import
fields.description: After the nightly bulk import the stock levels in Apollo stay at the old value. Warehouse shows 40 units, storefront shows 0. Happens on the THA site.

comments.body: Root cause: the import job dropped the delta file when the SFTP connection timed out. Fixed by retrying the fetch. See PRDT-402.

fields.summary: Out of stock products still purchasable on PDP
fields.description: Products with zero inventory are still showing as available on the product page and can be added to cart. Stock sync seems delayed.

comments.body: Cache TTL on the availability service was 6h. Reduced to 5m in PRDT-410.

fields.summary: Voucher STYLE15 not applying at checkout
fields.description: Customers report the STYLE15 voucher is rejected at checkout with 'invalid code' even though the campaign is live.

comments.body: Cart rule had a currency condition that excluded THB. Fixed in PRDT-455.

fields.summary: Product images missing on category page
fields.description: Category listing shows placeholder images for about 200 SKUs uploaded last week.

comments.body: Image CDN ingestion failed for filenames with spaces. PRDT-470.

fields.description: The tracking link in the shipping confirmation email returns a 404 page for orders shipped from the Bangkok warehouse.

comments.body: Tracking URL template used the old carrier path. PRDT-488.

fields.summary: Stock sync job stuck at 03:00 every night
fields.description: The stock sync job hangs at 03:00 and has to be restarted manually. Inventory is stale until someone notices.

comments.body: Deadlock on the inventory table during the nightly reindex. PRDT-502.

fields.summary: How do I export the daily order report?
fields.description: I need the daily order report for the merchandising team. Where do I get it?

comments.body: Apollo > Reports > Orders > Daily, then Export CSV. Scheduled exports can be set up under Reports > Schedules. Documented in the SOP.

fields.summary: Stock levels not updating after bulk import
fields.description: Bulk import ran last night on the THA warehouse but the storefront still shows the old stock numbers. Warehouse team confirms the file was uploaded.
